basic_details.job_title: Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026 Notification Out – Apply Offline for 89 Special Police Officer Posts

application_fee.details: The notification does not mention any application fee.

qualification.details: The retired personnel must be a permanent resident of Odisha.

salary_details.pay_scale: Fixed as per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No.24533/F dtd 22.09.2022
salary_details.details: The remuneration for Special Police Officers will be fixed as per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No.24533/F dtd 22.09.2022.

selection_process: The selection test includes verification of original documents
held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur.
A Medical Board shall test the physical fitness of the candidates

and the decision of the Board is final and binding. Persons with physical deformities shall not be eligible for appointment. Only those who are found medically fit are allowed to participate in further tests.
Candidates must be physically fit and mentally alert

and capable of discharging field duty by putting in hard labor for at least 8 hours a day during day or night. Candidates must cover a distance of 5 (five) Kilometers on foot within a period of one hour. Those who fail to cover the distance within the time will be disqualified.
Candidates who qualify in the medical test and physical test will appear before the Selection Board for an interview to test their suitability for appointment as Special Police Officers.
how_to_apply: Download the prescribed application form and detailed advertisement from the official Odisha Police website at police.odisha.gov.in.
Fill up all required columns of the application form neatly and completely in a typed format as per the provided Performa.
Attach two recent passport-size self-attested photographs.
Enclose self-attested copies of certificates in support of age, qualification, and discharge certificate.
Enclose two character certificates attested by two different Group-B Gazetted Officers.
Submit the completed application form along with all relevant documents to the Office of the D.I.G of Police, N.R., Sambalpur, on or before 31 October 2026 at 05:30 PM.
important_instructions: Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date of submission will be summarily rejected. The re-employed persons shall have to wear the uniform and the badge as prescribed by the D.G. & I.G. of Police, Odisha. Candidates are required to execute an agreement for re-employment on a contract basis for not more than one year. The selection test will be held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur on 10 November 2026 at 06:30 AM. The decision of the Medical Board regarding physical fitness is final and binding.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Vacancy Details (District-wise)
content_sections.text: A total of 89 vacancies are available for retired police personnel under the DIG of Police, NR, Sambalpur range.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Eligibility Criteria
content_sections.text: The retired personnel must be a permanent resident of Odisha.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Salary
content_sections.text: The remuneration for Special Police Officers will be fixed as per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No.24533/F dtd 22.09.2022.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Application Fee
content_sections.text: The notification does not mention any application fee.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Selection Process
content_sections.text: The selection test includes verification of original documents, medical test, physical test, and interview, held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur. A Medical Board shall test the physical fitness of the candidates, and the decision of the Board is final and binding. Persons with physical deformities shall not be eligible for appointment. Only those who are found medically fit are allowed to participate in further tests. Candidates must be physically fit and mentally alert, and capable of discharging field duty by putting in hard labor for at least 8 hours a day during day or night. Candidates must cover a distance of 5 (five) Kilometers on foot within a period of one hour. Those who fail to cover the distance within the time will be disqualified. Candidates who qualify in the medical test and physical test will appear before the Selection Board for an interview to test their suitability for appointment as Special Police Officers.

content_sections.heading: Odisha Police SPO Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Incomplete applications or applications received after the last date of submission will be summarily rejected. The re-employed persons shall have to wear the uniform and the badge as prescribed by the D.G. & I.G. of Police, Odisha. Candidates are required to execute an agreement for re-employment on a contract basis for not more than one year. The selection test will be held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur on 10 November 2026 at 06:30 AM. The decision of the Medical Board regarding physical fitness is final and binding.

faq.question: Q1. What is the Odisha Police Special Police Officer Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: It is a contractual recruitment process for retired Asst. Sub-Inspectors, Sub-Inspectors, and Inspectors of Police to fill 89 Special Police Officer (SPO) posts in Odisha Police for a period of one year.

faq.question: Q2. How many vacancies are available in Odisha Police SPO Recruitment 2026?
faq.answer: There are a total of 89 vacancies across districts including Jharsuguda (14), Baragada (18), Balangir (20), Sambalpur (28), and Subarnapur (09).

faq.question: Q3. What is the last date to submit the application form?
faq.answer: The last date to submit the application form is 31 October 2026 at 05:30 PM.

faq.question: Q4. What is the qualification required for Odisha Police SPO posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must be retired Asst. Sub-Inspectors, Sub-Inspectors, or Inspectors of Police from State Police with an unblemished service record and permanent residency in Odisha.

faq.question: Q5. What is the upper age limit for Odisha Police SPO recruitment?
faq.answer: Candidates must not be more than 65 years of age as on the date of publication of the advertisement.

faq.question: Q6. Is there any application fee for Odisha Police SPO recruitment?
faq.answer: The notification does not mention any application fee.

faq.question: Q7. How can I apply for Odisha Police SPO posts?
faq.answer: Candidates must submit their filled applications offline in the prescribed format to the Office of the D.I.G of Police, N.R., Sambalpur before the deadline.

faq.question: Q8. What is the selection process for Odisha Police SPO?
faq.answer: The selection process includes verification of original documents, a medical test, a physical test (covering 5 kilometers on foot in one hour), and an interview.

faq.question: Q9. When and where will the selection test be held?
faq.answer: The selection test will be held at Reserve Police Ground Sambalpur on 10 November 2026 at 06:30 AM.

faq.question: Q10. What is the salary for Odisha Police SPO?
faq.answer: The remuneration is fixed as per Government of Odisha, Finance Department Memo No.24533/F dtd 22.09.2022.
